name: LAN_FPS
notes: Next Gen online update: four new low-poly operatives (Rico, Dante, Lucia, Nina) on one shared rig; appearance creator with outfits, skin tones, Matte/Neon Rim shaders and accents that every player sees; new Control and Capture the Flag modes; modern combat HUD; fixes for guests not rendering, loading the wrong map and remote avatars not animating.
